name: List All Community Association Board Members
description: Returns Community Association (CA) Board of Director Member's details that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[AssociationId]
queryFilters.description: Filter by unique identifier of the Community Association. All GET requests must include a filter for [AssociationId] or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter by last updated date. All GET requests must include a filter for [AssociationId] or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the homeowner on the Board of Directors

responseFields.name: data[].AssociationId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the association related to the Board of Directors

responseFields.name: data[].Email
responseFields.description: The Board of Director member's primary email address

responseFields.name: data[].Emails
responseFields.description: The Board of Director member's emails

responseFields.name: data[].FirstName
responseFields.description: The first name of the Board of Director member

responseFields.name: data[].LastName
responseFields.description: The last name of the Board of Director member

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the CA Board of Director's details were last updated

responseFields.name: data[].MiddleName
responseFields.description: The middle name of the Board of Director member

responseFields.name: data[].PhoneNumber
responseFields.description: The Board of Director member's primary phone number

responseFields.name: data[].PhoneNumbers
responseFields.description: The Board of Director member's phone numbers

responseFields.name: data[].UnitId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the unit related to the Board of Directors

responseFields.name: data[].BoardMemberships
responseFields.description: Array containing details about Board of Director memberships

attributes.name: Role
attributes.description: The Board of Director member's role. Valid roles include President, Vice President, Treasurer, Secretary/Treasurer, Board Member or other.

attributes.name: StartDate
attributes.description: The Board of Director member's term start date

attributes.name: EndDate
attributes.description: The Board of Director member's term end date

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
